title: Learning object does not embed evidence
objective: Verify that learning objects reference evidence through source.evidence_refs but do not embed evidence inline. A learning object must never become a second evidence store.

source.description: QA-PILOT-LEARNING-OBJECT-CONTRACT-1: Learning object references evidence — does not become evidence

execution.criteria: All valid learning-object-v1 fixtures lack evidence creation fields (findings, evidence, seal, approve) at top level
execution.expected_outcome: Zero learning objects contain inline evidence fields

pass_criteria.description: No learning object has top-level 'findings' field
evidence_required: All LO fixtures pass validate-learning-object.py LO-13

pass_criteria.description: All generated learning objects validate against schema
